why_an_addendum_and_not_an_edit: PROVENANCE.json is frozen read-only. A new document for the same part is added alongside.
purpose: Published evidence of 1/f (flicker) noise of Linear Systems bipolar pairs, to derive SPICE KF/AF for the LS350 input mirror.

added_file.title: Linear Systems Company Data Book, Rev no. A01, 01012024 (347 pages)

noise_evidence.where: Application note 'Solving the Noise Puzzle with Low-Noise Matched Bipolar Transistor Pairs - LS310 & LS350', databook pages 325-332; Figure 3 'Noise Voltage and Noise Current Density as a Function of Frequency and Collector Current' on databook page 329 of 347 (PDF page 329). The figure is a raster image; read by eye from a 200 dpi render.
noise_evidence.WARNING_attribution: The figure caption does NOT say which device (LS310 NPN or LS350 PNP) the curves belong to. The note covers both. Treat as 'LS31x/LS35x family, unattributed'. The LS350 datasheet (LS350SeriesDSRevA5.pdf) itself has no noise curves; the LS350 pages of the databook (139-140) contain only the table.
noise_evidence.conditions: TA = 25 C; Ic = 10 uA (typical and worst case) and 300 uA (typical); Vce and Rs NOT stated (Rs ~ 0 for en, Rs ~ infinity for in is implied by the quantity, not stated); bandwidth 1 Hz density.
noise_evidence.axes_calibration_noise_current: x: 0.1 Hz .. 10 kHz log; y: 0.1 .. 100 pA/rtHz log

Ic_300uA_typ.note: straight line of slope -1/2 in amplitude (pure 1/f in power) over 3.9 decades, no white floor visible

Ic_10uA_typ.note: ends at ~0.1 pA, which is about the shot level of Ib ~ 33 nA (0.1 pA)

noise_evidence.reading_uncertainty: about +/-15 percent on the value, about +/-0.1 decade on the abscissa (raster, coarse log grid)

derived_by_agent_not_published.assumed_hFE: 300 (datasheet: hFE >= 200 at 10 uA..1 mA; actual unknown) so Ib = 1 uA and 33 nA
derived_by_agent_not_published.KF_with_AF_1.46_A_units: 5.7e-14 (order of magnitude; depends on assumed hFE)

what_was_not_verified: Which device the Figure 3 curves are. No data at 0.5-1 mA, the LS350 operating point of the project mirror: it is an extrapolation with AF about 1.4.
